capped_active_definition.rule: display_level == 'capped_active' iff qualified_level == 'active' AND is_blocked AND 'dominant' in blocked_from (alpha_level_classifier._activation_level_for, pre-existing, unmodified).
capped_active_definition.invariant: A genuinely dominant or regime_level Alpha is never downgraded to capped_active, even if itself blocked down from a still-higher target (e.g. dominant-blocked-from-regime_level stays plain 'dominant').

blocked_definition.shape: orthogonal: blocked (bool) + blocked_reason_codes (canonical 4-value subset) + cap_reason_codes (raw, uncanonicalized) exposed alongside display_level, never replacing it.

precedence.implementation: Implicit in alpha_level_classifier.classify_alpha_level's own Case A-D arbitration order (Case D checked before C before A/B) -- Step 7 does not reimplement or reorder this; normalize_alpha_display_state reads the already-arbitrated qualified_level/activation_level verbatim.

truth_table.condition: 70 <= score < 86, no dominant_cap_reason_codes, no exposure block
50 <= score < 70 but uncapped_score >= 70 and dominant_cap_reason_codes non-empty (or regime_gate failed while dominant also failed)
any of C/D/E above, blocked_reason_codes non-empty when is_blocked
truth_table.note: blocked is an orthogonal flag, never a fifth display_level.

truth_table.condition: zero qualifying evidence (activation_score forced to 0.0 by score_alpha_v2 when has_qualifying_evidence is False)
score >= 50 (active-band) with an authoritative gating condition preventing active status
truth_table.note: NOT REACHABLE in the current B4 model -- classify_alpha_level's Case A/B explicitly applies no qualification gate to candidate/active (John's own prior instruction, task section 7 of B4_ACTIVATION_LEVEL_ALIGNMENT: 'candidate/active have no qualification gate beyond the score itself'). Confirmed by test_b_candidate_and_active_never_gain_a_new_evidence_graph_or_exposure_gate.

truth_table.condition: score targets regime_level but BOTH regime_gate fails AND dominant_cap_reason_codes non-empty (multiple, distinct reason codes across dominant+regime diagnostics)
truth_table.note: All distinct diagnostic codes from both dominant and regime evaluation are preserved (deduped, never dropped) in diagnostic_reason_codes/blocked_reason_codes.
